purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Isiolo South Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve an internal source arithmetic conflict without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved), then re-cropped and upscaled around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. Every TOTAL-row digit is unambiguous and clearly printed. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake (id=5).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (ISIOLO SOUTH, code 050, county ISIOLO code 011) was read from the page header and cross-checked against the visible 'CON 050' banner marker printed on the TOTAL-row page itself before this row was accepted.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: Registered voters, total valid votes and rejected ballots are each individually clear and unambiguous on the printed TOTAL row, and registered voters reconciles exactly to the governed P23 denominator (22,181). However, the four candidate-vote cells on that same row sum to 16,196, exactly 2 less than the row's own printed Total Valid Votes figure of 16,198. This is a genuine internal arithmetic inconsistency on the official source form itself, not a transcription ambiguity. Per the extraction contract's prohibition on silently correcting digits to force reconciliation, this conflict is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence.
